post.description: Reads the line's Odoo contact now: links it by national ID if it is not linked yet (one match links it, none leaves it not_in_odoo, several leave it ambiguous for staff to pick), then stores the credit snapshot and every quota invoice. Odoo failures are kept as the line's last sync error. Advisors and administrators.
post.summary: Update a credit line from Odoo

post.description: Validates the payment (amount above zero and at most the invoice's balance, read from Odoo now; date not in the future, today when empty; a bank Odoo accepts; a reference not used by another payment) and sends it to Odoo, which applies it to the invoice's oldest installment. 201: registered. 200: Odoo already had that reference (status already_registered, nothing duplicated) or a double submission of a stored payment (replayed). 422 odoo_rejected: Odoo refused it; it is stored as failed with Odoo's code. 503: Odoo unavailable; nothing stored, retry with the same reference. Advisors and administrators.
post.summary: Register a rancher's payment in Odoo

get.description: What Prestia last read from TVGAN's Odoo for the line: the link to the Odoo contact, the credit snapshot Odoo computes (approved, used, available, overdue days, can buy and why not), the quota invoices with their installments (open ones first, by the due date of their oldest unpaid installment), the payments registered from Prestia and the block history. It does not call Odoo. Advisors and administrators.

Streams the signed PDF stored with the line, inline, named after the promissory note number. The bytes are hashed on every read: if they no longer match the SHA-256 registered with the line the PDF is not served (500, promissory_note_corrupted). Every access is recorded in the audit log. Advisors and administrators.

post.description: One unattended sync round, the same the in-process timer runs: active lines, least recently synced first, until the hourly request budget reaches the share kept for staff. post.summary: Update every credit line from Odoo (scheduler)

post.description: Decides a rancher's quota and stores the result. The holdings are summed: the quota is one per national ID. Under the tiers strategy (LIVESTOCK_QUOTA_STRATEGY, default) the quota is the pilot tier amount, or 0 when not eligible, with the supplied herd taken as the current cycle; under the engine strategy it is the engine's quota. engineQuota always carries the engine's figure.
post.summary: Assess a rancher's livestock credit quota

post.description: The partner informs that the rancher signed the promissory note and the quota is active. Prestia records the credit line with the signed PDF (registration only for now). The line must open the full quota of an assessment the same partner requested for the same national ID. Idempotent: replaying the same activation (same promissoryNoteNumber, partnerReference, assessment, national ID, amount and document) returns 200 with the line already registered; different data under the same promissory note, partner reference or assessment is 409. Error codes: invalid_request (400), document_too_large (413), not_a_pdf, sha256_mismatch, unknown_assessment, assessment_of_another_partner, national_id_mismatch, assessment_without_quota, currency_mismatch, amount_mismatch (422), promissory_note_already_registered, partner_reference_already_registered, assessment_already_activated (409).
post.summary: Register a livestock credit line activated by a partner

parameters.description: Signed promissory note (application/pdf, at most 10 MB)

post.description: Reads the national ID's herds from Fedegán's vaccination registry, decides the quota and stores the result. The partner sends only the identity; contact data is not returned. Under the tiers strategy (default) the quota is the pilot tier amount; a rancher in the RUV who reaches no tier gets 200 with quota 0, and 404 is kept for IDs the RUV does not know.

loan.description:
Loan is Prestia's credit on the invoice: Odoo's capital plus the
interest of the credit line's rate. Absent until opened.

nextDueDate.description: NextDueDate is the due date of the oldest installment with a balance.

paymentState.description: PaymentState: not_paid, in_payment, partial, paid or reversed.

activeCeiling.description:
ActiveCeiling is the ceiling that bound the engine's quota, or the tier
label under the tiers strategy.

engineQuota.description: EngineQuota is what the individual engine would have granted.

strategy.description: Strategy is how the quota was decided: tiers or engine.

tier.description:
Tier is the tier code (tier1, tier2, tier3, notEligible) and TierLabel
its name; both empty under the engine strategy.

assessment.description: Assessment is absent only if the stored assessment cannot be read.

clientId.description: ClientID is the rancher in Prestia's clients (absent until enrolled).

odoo.description:
Odoo is the line's link to TVGAN's Odoo and the overdue days and block
of its last credit snapshot.

partnerArchiveUri.description: PartnerArchiveURI is where the partner keeps its own copy (informative).

linkStatus.description: LinkStatus: pending, linked, not_in_odoo or ambiguous.

synced.description: Synced is whether Odoo's credit snapshot was ever read.

clientId.description:
ClientID and CreditLineID are the rancher and the credit line in
Prestia's own tables.

nationalId.description: NationalID matches exactly; empty lists every line.

status.description: Status filters by status (active); empty lists every status.

odoo.description:
Odoo is the line's link to TVGAN's Odoo and the overdue days and block
of its last credit snapshot.

blockReason.example: tiene cuotas vencidas (12 días de mora)

credit.description: Credit is absent until the first successful read.

enabled.description:
Enabled is whether Prestia has an Odoo token; without it the stored data
is shown and nothing can be sent.

capital.description:
Capital went to Odoo; Interest stays in Prestia, InterestPendingReport
until Odoo can take it.

replayed.description:
Replayed is a double submission answered with the payment already
stored; nothing was sent to Odoo.

interestPendingReport.description:
InterestPendingReport is the interest collected that Odoo has not been
told about yet (its API takes the capital only, for now).

invoices.description:
Invoices: open ones first, by the due date of their oldest unpaid
installment, then the paid ones.

suggestedInvoiceId.description:
SuggestedInvoiceID is the open invoice due first, which the payment
form preselects.

notVaccinated.description: NotVaccinated is the registry's unvaccinated total for the holding.

dueToday.description:
DueToday is what is due by today, interest included; PayoffToday adds
the capital not yet due (the most a payment today can be).

nominalAnnualRate.description: NominalAnnualRate is the rate it computes with (monthly × 12; 23.3433 = 26.01 % TEA).

outstandingCapital.description: OutstandingCapital is the capital not yet paid (what Odoo shows as the invoice's balance).

holdingStatus.description: HoldingStatus is the RUV's holding status; "N" (active) scores best.

reference.description: Reference is the caller's identifier for the request (e.g. its onboarding ID).

tenure.description: Tenure is "Propia" or "Arrendada", as the RUV reports it.

activeCeiling.description:
ActiveCeiling is what bound the quota: the engine's ceiling name, or
the tier label ("Escalón 1", "No elegible") under the tiers strategy.

activeCeilingCode.description:
ActiveCeilingCode is the stable key of ActiveCeiling: ltv, capacity,
inputs or policyCap, or the tier code under the tiers strategy. Branch
on this, not on the display text.

eligibleBasket.description: EligibleBasket is what the rancher would buy in the inputs catalogue over the term.

engineQuota.description:
EngineQuota is what the individual engine computes, under either
strategy, so the two can be compared.

projectedIncome.description: ProjectedIncome is the holding's expected revenue over the term.

quota.description:
Quota is the amount granted: the tier amount under the tiers strategy
(zero when not eligible), the engine's quota under the engine strategy.

strategy.description: Strategy is how Quota was decided: tiers or engine.

tier.description: Tier is the tier decision; absent under the engine strategy.

idType.description: IDType is the RUV's document type, e.g. "CÉDULA DE CIUDADANÍA" (default).

reference.description: Reference is the caller's identifier for the request (e.g. its onboarding ID).

synced.description: Synced is how many credit lines were refreshed from Odoo.

requirement.description:
Requirement is cedula, currentCycleRegistered, activeHolding,
vaccinatedHeads, vaccinationRate, ownedHolding or vaccinatedCycles.

scope.description:
Scope is "entry" for the entry filter, or the code of the tier whose
requirement was not met (the next tier up from the one granted).

code.description: Code is tier1, tier2, tier3 or notEligible.

currentCycle.description:
CurrentCycle is the RUV cycle measured ("2026-1"); CurrentCycleFound
whether any predio was recorded in it.

reasons.description:
Reasons are the failed entry filters, or what kept the rancher from the
next tier up; empty at the top tier.

vaccinationRate.description: VaccinationRate is a fraction with four decimals, e.g. "0.8500".

date.description: Date is YYYY-MM-DD, today when empty; never in the future.

idType.description: IDType is the RUV's document type, e.g. "CÉDULA DE CIUDADANÍA" (default).
